response.sql:
WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS payment_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
), store_averages AS (
  SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS avg_payment_total
  FROM rental_totals
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.payment_total) AS sum_of_above_average_rental_totals,
       AVG(rt.payment_total - sa.avg_payment_total) AS avg_excess_over_store_average
FROM rental_totals rt
JOIN store_averages sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id
WHERE rt.payment_total > sa.avg_payment_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id;

assumptions.assumption: Rentals with no linked payments have a missing payment total and are excluded from the store average and qualifying results; AVG ignores those NULL totals.
